baluchi.definition: n an Iranian language spoken in Pakistan and Iran and Afghanistan and Russia and the Persian gulf
baluchi.translation: n. 俾路支人,俾路支人讲的伊朗语

baluchis.translation:
n. 俾路支人；俾路支语（等于Balochi或者Baluch）
adj. 俾路支人的；俾路支语的（等于Balochi或者Baluch）

baluchithere.translation: n. [古生]俾路支兽(一种已绝种的古代巨兽)

baluster.definition: n. one of a number of closely spaced supports for a railing
baluster.translation: n. 栏杆的支柱, 栏杆

balusters.definition:
plural of baluster
n. one of a number of closely spaced supports for a railing
balusters.translation: (baluster 的复数) n. 栏杆的支柱, 栏杆

balustrade.definition: n a railing at the side of a staircase or balcony to prevent people from falling

balustraded.definition:
past tense of balustrade
n a railing at the side of a staircase or balcony to prevent people from falling
balustraded.translation: (balustrade 的过去时) n. 栏杆

balustrades.definition: n. a railing at the side of a staircase or balcony to prevent people from falling
balustrades.translation: n. （阳台的）栏杆, 扶手( balustrade的复数形式 )

balustrading.definition:
-ing form of balustrade
n a railing at the side of a staircase or balcony to prevent people from falling
balustrading.translation: (balustrade 的现在分词) n. 栏杆
